tasks.original_prompt:
Result routing: message the latest hemoglobin to the clinic of the clinician at this patient's most recent follow-up visit, and report the value and whether it is low.
Context: patient MRN SYN-3ae3148df2 (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2021-02-21, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. Consider only Observations coded LOINC 718-7 (hemoglobin) with status final or corrected and an effective date on or before the as-of date, in date order. A result is low when its value is below 12.0 g/dL for a patient whose Patient.gender is female and below 13.0 g/dL otherwise. The last follow-up visit is the most recent Encounter with status finished, a type coding with code followup-coordination and a period start on or before the as-of date; its clinician is the one Practitioner among its participants, and the clinic is the organization of the PractitionerRole whose practitioner is that clinician. answer is {"latest": ..., "still_low": ...}: latest is the most recent result, with exactly these keys: date (string: effective date, YYYY-MM-DD), value (number: valueQuantity.value exactly as recorded) and unit (string: valueQuantity.unit); still_low (boolean) is whether it is low. Create exactly this record (and nothing else), replacing $patient with the resolved Patient reference, $clinic with that Organization and $result with the latest result: {"resourceType": "Communication", "status": "completed", "subject": {"reference": "$patient"}, "recipient": [{"reference": "$clinic"}], "about": [{"reference": "$result"}]}. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the latest result, the Encounter, the PractitionerRole and the Organization), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. Change nothing else in the chart.

Reply with only JSON: {"answer": {latest: {date: date YYYY-MM-DD, unit: text, value: number}, still_low: true/false}, "evidence": [references of the records you used, Type/id]}. Use null for any value the chart does not have.
